cases.name: the loopback shim reports health and lists its models (chat completion not exercised)

argv: P=$((20000 + $$ % 20000)); "$1" serve --port $P --brief-bin "$2" > px.log 2>&1 & p=$!; sleep 1; curl -s --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:$P/health; echo; curl -s --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:$P/v1/models; kill $p

cases.name: a chat completion is answered with a brief of the last message, twice in a row, and an empty conversation is a 400

files.chat.json: {"model": "bonfyre-brief", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "We met the Dallas client Tuesday. They want checkout fixed before Friday. Pricing stays the same. Nick sends the revised quote tomorrow."}]}

argv: P=$((20000 + $$ % 20000)); "$1" serve --port $P --brief-bin "$2" > px.log 2>&1 & p=$!; sleep 1; curl -s --max-time 30 -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d @chat.json http://127.0.0.1:$P/v1/chat/completions; echo; curl -s --max-time 30 -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d @chat.json http://127.0.0.1:$P/v1/chat/completions; echo; curl -s --max-time 5 -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"messages\":[]}" -w " code=%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:$P/v1/chat/completions; echo; curl -s --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:$P/health; kill $p
contains: They want checkout fixed before Friday.
